description: For Individuals and HUFs having income from profits and gains of business or profession (not eligible for presumptive taxation under ITR-4) and includes partners of a firm.

fields.name: PAN & Personal Information
fields.description: Mandatory PAN, Aadhaar, and demographic details.

fields.name: Nature of Business (Part A-GEN)
fields.description: Select the specific business code (e.g., trading, manufacturing, services) and activity.

fields.name: Balance Sheet (Part A-BS)
fields.description: Balance sheet details as on 31st March, including proprietor's capital, loans, fixed assets, and closing stock.

fields.name: Manufacturing/Trading/P&L Account (Part A-P&L)
fields.description: Details of opening stock, purchases, sales, direct/indirect expenses, and net profit.

fields.name: Other Income (Schedules S, HP, CG, OS)
fields.description: Income from salaries, house property, capital gains, or other sources like interest.

fields.name: Depreciation (Schedule DPM/DOA/DEP)
fields.description: Depreciation allowable under Income Tax Rules on various blocks of assets (machinery, building, intagibles).

fields.name: Computation of Business Income (Schedule BP)
fields.description: Converting accounting profit to taxable profit by adding disallowed expenses (like personal expenses) and deducting allowed ones.

fields.name: Deductions (Chapter VI-A)
fields.description: Investments in PPF, LIC, medical insurance, and other specified eligible tax savings.

fields.name: Schedule FA & AL
fields.description: Foreign Assets details (if residing in India) and Assets & Liabilities statement (mandatory if total income > ₹50 Lakh).

fields.name: Tax Computation (Part B-TTI)
fields.description: Computation of total tax, adjusting TDS/TCS, advance tax, and arriving at refund or tax payable.
